lead_raw_text:
The structure of LiMnAs2O6 is monoclinic, space group C2/c (No. 15), with a 40-atom unit cell (Li8Mn4As8O24) and six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies tetrahedral As centers coordinated by four O neighbors and octahedral Li centers coordinated by six O neighbors, while Mn adopts an octahedral environment with six O neighbors. Corner-sharing is observed between As tetrahedra and Li or Mn octahedra, and between Li and Mn octahedra, with a three-dimensional geometric neighbor graph.
